learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about a beautiful and historic Indian town famous for its grand forts and lovely weaving!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Maheshwar is an old and beautiful town situated on the banks of the mighty Narmada river. It has very big and strong forts from the past.
The town is famous because of a very kind and brave queen named Ahilyabai Holkar who did many great things for the people.

fun_activity.title: 🧱 Sandcastle Fort
fun_activity.instructions: Use building blocks or wet sand to build a strong fort just like the ones in the old town of Maheshwar!

quick_recap: ⭐ Maheshwar is a famous historical town near the Narmada river.
⭐ It is well known for its grand forts and special woven clothes.
⭐ Queen Ahilyabai was a great leader who loved her people.
